skill.name: frontend-design
skill.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Use this skill when the user asks to build web components, pages, or applications. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.
skill.summary: Guide AI agents to create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with strong visual direction.
skill.author: AJV009

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 7 describes frontend design goals and asks for working interface code. It does not request host inspection, system discovery, or sensitive data access.
Line 30 discusses font selection and warns against generic fonts. The phrase relates to visual design, not operating system reconnaissance.

content.value_statement: Frontend builders often need polished interfaces that feel specific to the product, not generic templates. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward bold visual direction, careful composition, and working implementation.
actual_capabilities: Defines a strong aesthetic direction before implementation begins.
Selects typography, color, spacing, backgrounds, and motion with clear intent.
Encourages working frontend code in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, or Vue.
Pushes interfaces away from common AI design patterns.
Balances maximalist and minimalist styles based on the product context.
limitations: Does not include ready-made component files or reusable assets.
Does not perform security review of generated frontend code.
Relies on the host agent to implement and test the final interface.
May need user constraints for accessibility, browser support, and performance targets.

use_cases.title: Set Product Direction
use_cases.description: Set a visual direction for a new product screen before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Build Better Components
use_cases.description: Build a page or component with stronger layout, typography, motion, and styling choices.

use_cases.title: Prototype A Launch Screen
use_cases.description: Create a polished prototype that communicates a product idea without using a generic landing page style.

prompt_templates.title: Start A Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a pricing card component for a small SaaS product. Choose a clear aesthetic and provide working implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Design A Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to build a product dashboard page for operations teams. Prioritize scanability, restrained styling, and efficient workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Refine An Existing UI
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to redesign my existing checkout screen. Preserve the flow, improve visual hierarchy, and explain the key design decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Build A Complete Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the frontend-design skill to create a responsive analytics application. Include navigation, empty states, loading states, and a distinctive visual system.

output_examples.input: Build a homepage for a boutique architecture studio.
output_examples.output: A full-page concept with editorial typography, asymmetrical image placement, restrained motion, and a working responsive implementation.

output_examples.input: Improve an admin dashboard that feels too generic.
output_examples.output: A denser operational layout with clearer hierarchy, better spacing, subdued color, and practical hover and loading states.

output_examples.input: Create a playful onboarding flow for a finance app.
output_examples.output: A multi-step interface concept with confident illustrations, accessible controls, purposeful transitions, and concise copy.

best_practices: Provide the product context, target audience, and technical stack before asking for implementation.
State required accessibility, browser, and performance constraints early.
Ask for responsive states and interaction states when the interface must ship.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a generic beautiful page without product context.
Do not accept decorative motion that distracts from the main workflow.
Do not ignore text fit, responsive behavior, or accessibility details.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create distinctive web components, pages, and applications with strong visual direction and working frontend implementation.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it generate production code?
faq.answer: It asks the host agent to implement functional frontend code, but final quality depends on review and testing.

faq.question: Is it only for landing pages?
faq.answer: No. It can guide components, dashboards, applications, flows, and full pages.

faq.question: Does it include assets?
faq.answer: No. It provides design and implementation guidance, not bundled images, fonts, or component libraries.

faq.question: How should I prompt it?
faq.answer: Describe the product, audience, required stack, and desired interaction depth.
